rationale: Ground truth shows no substantive reviewer concerns (just LGTM/approve), so both candidates correctly find no blockers and both verify the PR's technical claims against source with plausible, specific line citations. X goes further by surfacing two concrete, actionable follow-ups (a regression test to guard the untested extra_body/root distinction, and a stale cross-reference in examples/online_serving/minicpmo/README.md) with precise file:line targets and rationale, while Y's single comment is hedged and non-actionable ('worth a sanity check... but if you observed silent WAV directly, keep the current wording'). Both are similarly grounded and neither has a gap-check section, but X's suggestions are more concrete and useful to a maintainer.
